command:
set -eu; echo '=== OMEGA VPS READ-ONLY INVENTORY ==='; date -u +%FT%TZ; id; uname -a; printf '
-- filesystem --
'; df -hT; printf '
-- workspace --
'; pwd; find /workspace -maxdepth 2 -mindepth 1 -printf '%y %p
' 2>/dev/null | sort | head -n 300; printf '
-- likely entity/omega paths --
'; find /workspace /var/lib /opt -maxdepth 3 \( -iname '*entityos*' -o -iname '*omega*' -o -iname '*franken*' -o -iname '*unified*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | sort | head -n 300; printf '
-- desktop binaries --
'; for x in Xorg Xvfb weston startxfce4 xfce4-session startlxqt openbox chromium google-chrome firefox; do command -v "$x" 2>/dev/null || true; done; printf '
-- processes --
'; ps -eo pid,comm,args --sort=comm | grep -Ei 'podman|entity|franken|omega|Xorg|Xvfb|weston|xfce|lxqt|chrome|chromium|firefox' | head -n 200 || true; printf '
-- network egress metadata --
'; getent hosts github.com 2>/dev/null | head -n 5 || true; printf '
=== END READ-ONLY INVENTORY ===
'
